title: Dashboard redesign and Clerk
summary: The next version of Loops arrives with a redesigned dashboard and a new Clerk integration.
body_markdown:
## Dashboard redesign


We just launched Part 1 of our 3 part redesign of Loops. I wrote[more about the redesign process](https://loops.so/updates/our-first-redesign) .


The first part of our redesign focuses on the Dashboard and Nav.


The most apparent visual changes are a more compact UI, better support across devices, keyboard selection (up, down, enter) and sorting by top level metrics like last updated and opens.


This is not a phased roll out, everyone has access to the redesign. You can check it out in your account today.


Your feedback is deeply appreciated, just ping[\[email protected\]](https://loops.so/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#c2a1aab0abb182aeadadb2b1ecb1ad) .


## New integration: Clerk


[Clerk](https://clerk.com/) is one of our most popular requests and we’re delighted to offer an integration with them today. You can set it up in Loops today or check out the docs[on Loops](https://loops.so/docs/integrations/clerk#clerk) or[on Clerk](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/development/webhooks/loops) .


—


Next week is our final big release for the month, then we’ll be back to our regularly scheduled monthly updates.
